items.summary: The third quarter earnings season is over halfway done, and the reports continue to pour in.

items.title: Look Who I Found creator is sleeping 3 hours a night to build a $1 billion brand
items.summary:
Look Who I Found host Tara Keeney has interviewed Oprah Winfrey, Kim Kardashian, Airbnb cofounder and CEO Brian Chesky, and many other leaders and celebrities. Her pitch is simple: “Let’s go for a walk.”

On Fortune Daily, she told Ellie Austin she runs a one-woman business and is aiming to build a $1 billion media company.

items.summary: The vacation rental site reported double-digit increases in nights and seats booked and in gross booking value for the third quarter.

items.title: Airbnb (NASDAQ:ABNB) surprises with Q3 2026 sales, stock jumps 11.7%
items.summary: Online accommodations platform Airbnb (NASDAQ:ABNB) beat Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q3 2026, with revenue up 18.9% year on year to $4.87 billion. Its GAAP profit of $3.16 per share was 11% above analysts’ consensus estimates.

items.title: Airbnb beats third-quarter estimates as travel demand accelerates
items.summary: Investing.com -- Airbnb reported stronger-than-expected third-quarter earnings and revenue on Thursday, as resilient travel demand, higher booking volumes and improved pricing helped the home-sharing platform deliver its fastest revenue growth in more than three years.

items.title: Airbnb Stock Jumps After Q3 Earnings Beat
items.summary: Airbnb stock jumped late Thursday after the online vacation rental platform posted Q3 results that easily beat estimates.
